title: Alan Mok Engineering
description: alanmokengineering.com Alan Mok Engineering Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based mechanical and electrical engineering contractor founded in 2000, providing HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, electrical and low voltage systems for commercial, industrial, marine and institutional projects. With 100 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 30 million Singapore dollars, it delivers full-cycle M&E services from design through commissioning and maintenance. Its specializations include chillers, ducting, sprinkler systems, electrical distribution, lightning protection and marine HVAC. The company holds BCA accreditation and bizSAFE certification with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 standards. Projects span condominiums, office towers, factories, hospitals, schools and shipyards across Singapore. Led by founder Alan Mok, it has built a 26-year track record in Singapore's competitive M&E engineering market.
